hooks.command: bash -c 'i=$(cat); case $i in *merge*|*update-branch*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}; f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap "rm -f -- $f" EXIT; if ! git -C "$d" show origin/feat-cmux-next:scripts/ci/guards-from-base.sh > "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "cmux guards: cannot read scripts/ci/guards-from-base.sh at origin/feat-cmux-next; the merge guards did not run" >&2; exit 1; fi; printf %s "$i" | bash "$f" "$d"'
